metadata.title: Hodge-Carleman estimates and global attractors for heterogeneous elastic waves with localized damping on Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study the long-time dynamics of the semilinear Lamé system of isotropic elasticity on a compact Riemannian manifold with boundary, for a heterogeneous medium whose density and Lamé moduli vary in space, under a frictional dissipation which acts only on an open set $\omega$. The elastic operator is the divergence of the Hooke stress tensor, and the starting point is a structural identity which shows that the dilatation and the vorticity of the displacement satisfy wave equations with the pressure and the shear speeds, respectively, coupled to the displacement only through first-order terms. A single weight function, free of critical points and strictly convex with respect to the two ray metrics of the medium, then serves for the displacement, its dilatation and its vorticity alike, and this Hodge structure yields Carleman estimates for the Lamé operator with variable coefficients at two energy levels, provided that $\omega$ contains a neighbourhood of the boundary and that such a weight exists on the undamped region. The hypothesis is fulfilled on every compact manifold with boundary by damping regions of arbitrarily small volume. From these estimates we derive unique continuation for elastic waves with bounded, merely measurable, time-dependent potentials and an internal observability inequality, which in turn yield, for subcritical restoring forces in dimension three, a compact global attractor which coincides with the unstable manifold of the equilibria, has finite fractal dimension and is bounded in $(H^2\cap H^1_0)\times H^1_0$, together with a generalized exponential attractor.

analysis.workSummary: 对紧带边黎曼流形上非均匀弹性介质的半线性 Lamé 系统，通过散度与旋度的 Hodge 结构建立局部阻尼下的 Carleman 估计和可观测性，并在三维次临界条件下得到有限维全局吸引子。
techniques: 双射线度量的共同权重
analysis.breakthrough: 统一压缩波与剪切波的权重，导出非均匀介质的耗散动力学结论。
analysis.limitations: 阻尼需含边界邻域，未阻尼区需共同严格凸权重；吸引子结论另有维数和非线性限制。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 以几何为工具的弹性波分析，适合可观测性方向专题阅读。
